remove.reason: Official GEO design centers on hepatic cell-model comparisons; the three liver-RNA samples lack defensible donor and health semantics for the strict reference cohort.

add.review_rationale: ENCODE4 unreplicated bulk total-RNA sample from adult right-lobe liver; explicit BioSample and donor ID. Hypertension is recorded as a non-hepatic comorbidity, so this remains a transparent reserve rather than a nominally healthy control.

remove.reason: Mixing epidermis and dermis creates a compartment confound and donor pairing is not exposed in ARCHS4 metadata.

add.review_rationale: Age- and sex-matched healthy controls from the PRP study; conservatively retain only control epidermis and exclude dermis to avoid a compartment mixture.

remove.reason: The healthy-skin rep labels do not prove whether replicates are biological or technical.

add.review_rationale: Healthy-skin control series; retain one deterministic sample until BioSample-level evidence resolves the rep labels.

next_gate: Resolve the conservative selectors, derive auditable donor keys, and assess study-cluster power without expression.
